'''Isshthar''' was a short-tempered [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] who nearly ripped off the [[Limb/Legends|arm]] of [[Sarliss]] because they disagreed about something. When Isshtharr was not using violence to solve problems, he asked his peers to find out how things worked. Unfortunately for him, not many could understand what he was saying. Isshthar was [[Slavery/Legends|enslaved]] before he joined the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebellion]], and was saved from the mines on [[Kirtania]] by [[Ran Niall]]. When suspicion arises on [[Resolute Base]], [[Var Narek]] puts Isshtharr up as a suspect to drive attention away from him.<ref name="OAA1" />
